1. [HIGH][statement-contradiction] F1 — R1/R3, AC1/AC3/AC13 (§4.4 Field-width/Preview-feasibility; §4.5 Failure modes). Pages are sized against "the configured delivery ceiling", yet handles are invalidated only by TTL, eviction, retirement or restart; a supported config reload changing `delivery_ceiling_bytes` either shifts page boundaries (R4's identical-bytes promise) or leaves pages above the new ceiling (R3). State that the ceiling/partition is pinned at retention or that a ceiling change invalidates handles.
